sentence: Industry-4.0 manufacturers convert AI capabilities into sustainability performance far better than traditional ones
passage: [Renfei et al. (2026), p. 1] "The impact of AIC on CSP is significantly weaker in traditional manufacturing firms than in Industry 4.0 manufacturing firms."

gemini.note: The passage directly supports the sentence, as stating the impact of AIC on CSP is 'significantly weaker in traditional manufacturing firms' is equivalent to saying Industry-4.0 firms do it far better.
